text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer, I'm back.
choice_data_list: That was a great result, wasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah, thanks!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Still... *phew*...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: No, I'm fine!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"It's just that Hayahide's spirit was so intense.
I don't really know how I managed to win, to be honest...
My head is still spinning..."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Taishin was like that during the Osaka Hai too,
but both of them felt like completely different people.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: How should I put it... was I the only one――

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wait, no, no, no! Can't be getting timid now!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm putting my all into running the best race possible too,
and my spirit won't lose to anyone!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"I'll work harder and harder,
and put on races that get everyone even more hyped!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—Running the ultimate race to fire everyone up.
I believe she said something like that before the race, too.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Hayahide!
We had another thrilling race today!
I felt your fighting spirit the entire time!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Let's keep putting on the greatest races together as rivals!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: “It may seem a bit comical for someone who just ran such an unseemly race to say this, but—”

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ticket. I... cannot see you as a rival
as you are right now.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Taishin would probably say the exact same thing.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh... N-No, wait, wait, hold on!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Why?! We've been racing against each other this whole time!
We even went all-out against each other in the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Back at the Derby,
we were rivals, without a shadow of a doubt.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: But—now is different.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean, it's different... I ran an awesome race today, too!
Just like at the Derby—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"It's not the same.
It's entirely different now, Ticket."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If you haven't even noticed that difference...
then I truly can't call you my rival anymore.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What I seek in a race
is different from what you call the 'ultimate race.'

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps you should think once more
about why you run in races?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ah... Hayahide...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"...Am I not a rival anymore...?
What am I... running for...?"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I want to...
run the ultimate race alongside my rivals
and get the crowd all fired up...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Am I... doing something wrong...?
Her shoulders trembling slightly, Winning Ticket muttered under her breath.
